question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: four requests, all reproduced by the command below: GET the merchant's /.well-known/ucp; then, to the shopping endpoint it names, a tools/list, a tools/call of create_checkout carrying the vendor's own published example agent profile and one line item whose product variant id is gid://shopify/ProductVariant/0, an id that cannot exist, and the same tools/call shape for get_order as a control. No Authorization header and no HTTP signature on any of them, and no MCP initialize: the endpoint answers a bare tools/call.

decoded.discovery: the merchant document names version 2026-08-25, a dev.ucp.shopping service over MCP at a myshopify.com endpoint, and capabilities dev.ucp.shopping.checkout, cart, fulfillment, discount, order and catalog
decoded.tools-list: 200 with 13 tools: get_checkout, create_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout, cancel_checkout, get_cart, create_cart, update_cart, cancel_cart, get_order, search_catalog, lookup_catalog, get_product. No www-authenticate header on this or any other response here
decoded.create-checkout: 200 with isError true and a UCP envelope of status error, one message: code invalid, severity unrecoverable, path $.line_items[0].item.id, content 'The merchandise with id gid://shopify/ProductVariant/0 does not exist.' No authentication error of any kind, and no checkout: the envelope's continue_url is the storefront root
decoded.control-get-order: the same anonymous tools/call shape for get_order answers HTTP 403 and JSON-RPC error -32000 AuthenticationRequired, 'Unauthorized: A valid JWT is required to call get_order', before any argument of the call is validated
decoded.not-measured: whether a well-formed anonymous create_checkout succeeds was not tested, because that would create a session on a merchant's store; no cart, checkout, order or payment was created

finding: The vendor's own pages disagree about whether an agent needs a credential to build a checkout. The tier table says the Anonymous tier may use "checkout build/edit tools"; the Cart MCP page says "Checkout MCP isn't available without authentication" and the Checkout MCP page says "All requests require authentication or a signed request" (all three re-read 2026-09-20). What this measures is narrower than any of those sentences, and it is a comparison rather than a success: an anonymous create_checkout was not refused for want of a credential and passed through to merchandise validation, failing on the impossible variant id the request deliberately carried, at that item's JSON path; the same anonymous request shape for get_order was refused by name with AuthenticationRequired at the same endpoint in the same minute. So the endpoint does evaluate credentials, and create_checkout is not one of the tools it gates (the whole map is in p-20260920-shopify-ucp-tool-auth-gate). It does not establish that a well-formed anonymous checkout succeeds: that was not attempted, and a valid checkout could fail at a later layer. One merchant, one minute, the vendor's own store.

reproducibility.command: E=https://1da1f2-7c.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mcp;A='{"meta":{"ucp-agent":{"profile":"https://shopify.dev/ucp/agent-profiles/examples/2026-08-25/valid-with-capabilities.json"}},"checkout":{"currency":"USD","line_items":[{"quantity":1,"item":{"id":"gid://shopify/ProductVariant/0"}}]}}';c(){ curl -sSD- -X POST $E -H'content-type: application/json' -d"{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"method\":\"$1\",\"params\":$2}";};curl -s https://hardware.shopify.com/.well-known/ucp;c tools/list {};for t in create_checkout get_order;do c tools/call "{\"name\":\"$t\",\"arguments\":$A}";done
